title: Aura — Generative Component System
tagline: An experimental component library bridging systemic design tokens with reactive web animations.
description: Aura was born from a curiosity to see how far web design systems can stretch when micro-interactions are driven by design tokens rather than isolated CSS hacks. Built using custom CSS variables, accessible ARIA primitives, and fluid layout math.
metrics: Used in 4 internal prototypes, 99+ Web Vitals Score

caseStudy.problem: Traditional design systems often isolate visual design tokens from fluid motion, resulting in rigid, lifeless interfaces.
caseStudy.solution: Created a token-driven animation engine where spacing, shadow, and color scale dynamically with mouse proximity and scroll momentum.
highlights: Modular architecture supporting light & dark themes seamlessly
Sub-10ms render latency for dynamic glassmorphic card surfaces
Comprehensive Figma token bridge for automated export

title: QuantFlow — Apprentice Analytics Platform
tagline: Real-time market insights dashboard designed for intuitive data exploration.
description: Explored during my apprenticeship at Fyers Securities. Designed to simplify multi-asset market analytics into actionable visual summaries using high-density data visualizations.
metrics: 35% faster insight discovery, zero visual clutter

caseStudy.problem: Financial charts often overwhelm non-expert traders with dense numbers and unorganized data feeds.
caseStudy.solution: Redesigned the onboarding and analytics workflow into contextual visual widgets with custom metric filtering.
highlights: Interactive query builder with SQL data pipeline backend
Automated event tracking integrated via Postman API suites
Custom neon dark theme optimized for multi-monitor setups

title: Pulse — Daily Focus & Habit Experience
tagline: Cross-platform mobile companion for deep work and mental momentum.
description: Built using React Native and Python/Flask backend. Focuses on frictionless interaction flows, offline-first data sync, and delightful micro-haptics.

caseStudy.problem: Most productivity apps add administrative overhead instead of removing friction.
caseStudy.solution: Created a single-tap gesture interface with zero onboarding form friction and immediate visual feedback.
highlights: Flask REST API for lightweight state persistence
Custom SVG chart visualizations for weekly focus trends

title: Echo — Intelligent Document Synthesizer
tagline: AI-powered workspace transforming long-form content into visual graphs.
description: A curiosity project exploring how natural language processing can augment document exploration. Synthesizes text documents into interactive knowledge maps.
metrics: Processed over 500+ document pages in test runs

caseStudy.problem: Reading multi-page research papers and project briefs makes finding cross-references tedious.
caseStudy.solution: Combined NLP parsing with a node-graph visualizer built on top of Django APIs.
highlights: Automatic entity extraction and keyphrase summarization
Interactive node graph UI with custom filtering
Deployed on AWS with scalable static asset hosting
